XMLStylesContext retains style leaf references per container; Writer retains independent common and active automatic references and replaces the automatic context when a new container is encountered. Direct lookup checks the active automatic family/name first; automatic and common parents resolve only through common definitions. Found automatic deltas survive missing parents; missing paragraph references keep the default paragraph. Context ownership assertions and fifteen literal real ODT cases verify legal common/automatic collisions, same-name parents, independent families, named-only chains, empty/missing parents, stream replacement and common-only default publication through export/reimport. The previously source-invalid automatic-parent list export chain now puts its inherited base in common styles; exact pinned tdf114287 geometry remains unchanged across package cycles. This export bridge and broader named document-model ownership still require separate architecture audit; no whole-module parity promotion.

For the existing LABEL_ALIGNMENT mode and LISTTAB/SPACE/NOTHING separators, source-owned xmlnumi parsing now retains zero defaults and MM100 fields with native Converter grammar/failure and SHRT bounds. The MM100 import port now carries both independent native geometry groups; the earlier legacy-to-alignment Twip emulation is removed. Writer numbering property conversion follows unosett.cxx signed MM100/Twip ratios; export projects native MM100 and delegates CM serialization to XML/SAX. ODF 1.3 XML emits explicit label-alignment mode and retains standard command geometry; indents are nonzero-only and tab position is exported only for LISTTAB with a positive value. Context/core assertions and eleven literal common/automatic ODT cases plus both default command marker families verify native quantization, conditional XML and manual reopen state. Full numbering/UNO, legacy position mode/property ownership, NEWLINE extensions, other XML units/versions, defaults and wider obligations remain unverified; no whole-module promotion.

Declared levels retain independent native legacy and alignment geometry with zero defaults; only exact label-alignment selects modern mode. SvxNumberFormat in editeng owns positional state, signed widths and mode-dependent getters; Writer inherits and copies all fields. xmlnumi owns level/property contexts and MM100 legacy parsing/assembly. Writer conversion precedes core application, and xmlnume emits the selected group with native signs and omission predicates. Thirteen literal common/automatic ODT cases verify mode spellings/absence, child presence, independent state, signed/bounded/partial/invalid legacy fields, exact XML and reopen. Clone and browser snapshots preserve inactive fields; primitive browser geometry selects the active group. Full line layout, numbering families, omitted-level construction, native UNO replacement failures (including signed SymbolTextDistance narrowing), extensions and wider contracts/defaults remain separately unverified. No whole-module promotion.
